push.title: W 1-0 vs UK Chargers | You: 7.6 (worst match performance)
push.body:
A 7.6 against UK Chargers, BellyTb1. Your worst match performance. We'll get you back.

THE GOOD
+ 2 key passes. You were the playmaker, the matchmaker and the good-time maker.
+ A goal against UK Chargers, your 5th straight match scoring. Right place, right time, right foot.
+ 5th straight match at 7.5 match rating. I'd put that on a billboard if I could afford one.
+ Misplaced passes 7, from 12 in your previous match. That doesn't happen by accident.
+ Another W: 1-0 over UK Chargers.

THE BAD
- No tackles attempted (down from your usual 2). Think about this: When the ball is lost, the nearest player presses and everyone else closes the passing lanes.
- 71% passing (17 of 24). Here's the play: If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too. Patience, partner.
- Rating came in 0.5 below what your on-ball stats earned. Keep this in your pocket: Your rating came in lower than your stats say, and that gap is off-ball: positioning, interceptions, blocks.
- You and PhogsToffees, same forcing passes homework. Partners: give each other short options.
- Shots 2, down from your usual 5. That has to tighten up.

Practice prescription: Defend the space, not just the player. Stand in the lane they want to pass into.

Hey, BellyTb1. Stay humble, hustle hard, hydrate harder.

Go easy on yourself tonight. Go hard at it tomorrow. - Coach Lasso
